item.title: Bennett publishes Together party list
item.description:
Naftali Bennett, chairman of the “Together" party, published his party slate for the Knesset ahead of the elections.
Former Finance and Transportation Ministry director-general Keren Turner will be placed second on the list, former Communications Ministry director-general Liran Avisar Ben-Horin will be third, and former Ra’anana Municipality director-general Michal Hirsch NagrI will be fourth. Knesset member Eitan Ginzburg will be fifth.
They will be followed, in order, by: Yonatan Shalev, Bruria Naim Arman, Amir Strugo, Nisan Zeevi, Orly Harel, Shahar Varon, Esti Ayalon Kovo, Jeremy Saltan, Zvi Plotnitsky, Olesya Kantor, Mati Gil, Tomer Weiner, Tami Muziel, Yael Stern and Amit Barda.

item.title: No Elections Needed: Moses' last day
item.description: On his final day, Moses does not look back - he prepares Israel for the future, passes the mantle to Joshua, and leaves behind a timeless lesson in leadership, humility and faith.

item.title: Water Authority: Water supplies to residents and agricultural sector continuing as normal
item.description: The Water Authority and the Ministry of Energy reported that the systems remain stable and that water supplies to residents and the agricultural sector are continuing as normal. At the same time, it was decided to purchase a dedicated stock of membranes for desalination facilities, and the public was asked to use water efficiently and responsibly.

item.title: Zamir warns IDF must be ready for surprise attack across all fronts
item.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir says Israel’s military must remain ready for a surprise attack as commanders test responses to a rapidly escalating multi-front war.

item.title: Survey: 94% surge in number of doctors who left Israel within 3 years
item.description: A Tel Aviv University study found that approximately 1,370 doctors left Israel for at least one year between 2023 and 2025, nearly twice the number a decade earlier.

item.title: Possessing a rocket: Hamas terror cell thwarted in northern Jordan Valley
item.description: The IDF announced that in a joint operation with the Israel Police and Shin Bet in the Akraba area, a Hamas terrorist cell was thwarted, 10 terrorists were apprehended and a rocket was located.

item.title: Adidas faces boycott calls over Israeli veteran featured in campaign
item.description: Sportswear giant Adidas is facing boycott calls over a campaign in Israel featuring former IDF soldier Shalev Biton, who lost his left leg after being wounded while fighting near Gaza.

item.title: Profile 70 | IDF moves to increase number of combat soldiers
item.description: The Medical Corps and Manpower Directorate have developed a new medical fitness classification intended to immediately expand the pool of candidates eligible for combat service.

item.title: 250 days alone at sea: Israeli sailor makes history in grueling round-the-world race
item.description: Daniel Pinsky, a 35-year-old sailor from Ariel, is the first Israeli to take part in the Golden Globe race; over 250 days, he will sail alone around the world, with no stops, crew, or GPS, relying only on paper maps and compasses.

item.title: Called for Jihad | Terrorist turned Instagram into channel for terror incitement
item.description: A serious indictment has been filed against a terrorist who disseminated inciting content on social media, praised terrorist attacks, and called for attacks against Jews.

item.description: Members of the Central Elections Committee have once again authorized parties to use apps to track and transmit real-time data on reported voters on Election Day.
